string.name: smart_road_condition_alerts_dialog_desc

string.name: smart_road_condition_alerts
string.value: Smart road condition alerts

string.name: smart_road_condition_alerts_desc
string.value: Get traffic light prompts when riding or driving.

string.name: smart_road_condition_alerts_mode_one
string.value: Amap can show the status of traffic lights as you travel. This feature will be enabled when requested by the system, and needs to collect location information at frequent intervals to work properly. You can disable this feature at any time by closing the live view window or turning the focus off in system Settings. This feature will automatically turn itself off if you've stopped riding or driving for a period of time.

string.name: smart_road_condition_alerts_mode_two
string.value: This feature uses a third-party map service to determine your current location and direction of travel. By turning this on, you agree to these terms.

string.name: smart_road_condition_alerts_mode_three
string.value: Amap does not have location access. Please open the app and grant location access.
